AUTHOR: Coro
TITLE: An intelligent and cost-effective remote underwater video device for fish size monitoring
REGION: NR (deep-sea 100-700 m videos from online collections; own shallow-water site, location not stated)
SPECIES: Large fish events (target sharks, tunas, mantas/rays; class-agnostic detection)
DATA: 5 test cases (T1: 15 short deep-water baited/unbaited RUV clips; T2-T5: own shallow unbaited RUV videos ~5.5 min each); synthetic Maya development videos for tuning
V_EV: Sec. 2.10: 'A shallow water scenario (~3m depth), with no bait used, and visible light had a ~10m maximum visibility.'; T1 'visibility up to ~1m'; per-test-case results in Table 3
D2: No training; parameters tuned on synthetic development videos, tested on 5 separate real field test cases
D_EV: Sec. 2.9-2.10: 'development case videos were built by modelling, rigging, and animating fishes with the Autodesk Maya software'; 'tested on five videos recorded by underwater remote devices in real deployment scenarios'
R_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'YOLO is distributed as pre-trained with the Microsoft's Common Objects in Context (COCO) dataset'; applied to underwater test cases (Table 3) with no in-domain performance reported
C_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The tuning of UDMOS on the development set estimated the values of all configuration parameters (Table 2): The optimal deep learning threshold ... (0.1)'
E_EV: Sec. 2.11: 'Segments containing an event were considered true positives (TPs)... Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F-measure' (event-detection metrics only; size not evaluated)
ARCH: Tiny-YOLOv3 (COCO-pretrained, class-agnostic boxes) + heuristic size analyser; alternatives Otsu-based unsupervised detector and motion detector
METR: Segment-level precision, recall, accuracy, F-measure; processing time per frame
NOTE: No model training: Tiny-YOLO used off-the-shelf (COCO) -> R1=Y as off-the-shelf model tested outside training domain; no in-domain numbers so R3=N. D1 coded 영상(video) because tuning used synthetic videos and testing used separate real field videos; verifier should check whether D should instead be NR. Visibility given as approximate distances (~1 m, ~10 m) coded 기타 정량; strata by test case (deep IR vs shallow, illumination levels described qualitatively) coded V6=P. T1 includes giant squid/non-fish targets. Text is preprint version.
